additions.title: Willing Hearts - Kitchen Volunteering
additions.description: Prepare and pack meals, clean the kitchen and help with supplies. Daily four-hour shifts start at 5am, 9am and 1pm.
additions.eligibility: Age 5+. Ages 5-12 must be accompanied by a parent, teacher or other adult; ages 13+ may volunteer independently. Closed-toe shoes required. School groups of six or more should contact the organiser.

discovery.parental_consent: Ages 5-12 require adult accompaniment; separate consent requirements not specified.
discovery.restrictions: Age 5+. Ages 5-12 must be accompanied by a parent, teacher or other adult; ages 13+ may volunteer independently. Closed-toe shoes required. School groups of six or more should contact the organiser.
discovery.notes: Daily walk-in volunteering is offered. Group booking instructions conflict for exactly four participants; confirm with the organiser. This listing covers kitchen volunteering, not driving.

additions.title: ACRES - Animal Care Volunteer
additions.description: Help care for rescued wildlife through enclosure cleaning, food preparation, feeding and maintenance.
additions.eligibility: Age 18+. Written and spoken English required. Work can be physically tiring and outdoors. Only vegetarian or vegan food may be consumed on duty.

discovery.restrictions: Age 18+. Written and spoken English required. Work can be physically tiring and outdoors. Only vegetarian or vegan food may be consumed on duty.
discovery.notes: Interest registration is not acceptance. Monthly slot invitations go out on the 20th; register before the 15th to be included for the following month. Slots are first come, first served. Rabies, tetanus and influenza vaccinations are encouraged.

additions.title: ReadAble / CountAble - Teaching and Learning Volunteers
additions.description: Express interest in literacy or mathematics teaching, lesson planning and organisational support; shortlisted applicants attend taster sessions.
additions.eligibility: Volunteer age and student eligibility are not specified. Usually at least six months commitment; the form also offers a six-session option for confident mathematics teachers. Relevant experience or interest is requested for some classes.

discovery.restrictions: Volunteer age and student eligibility are not specified. Usually at least six months commitment; the form also offers a six-session option for confident mathematics teachers. Relevant experience or interest is requested for some classes.
discovery.notes: Only shortlisted applicants are contacted. Some classes are waitlisted. No application closing date is stated. Children's class ages are not volunteer age limits.

additions.title: Engineering Good - Makers and Laptop Maintenance Volunteers
additions.description: Support assistive technology projects or prepare donated laptops for refurbishment. Choose a role suited to your technical skills.
additions.eligibility: The organiser states volunteers must be at least 18 unless a programme specifies otherwise. Maker roles need fabrication skills; laptop work needs confidence handling and reassembling devices. Laptop sessions are on weekdays, 10am-5pm, by arrangement.

discovery.restrictions: The organiser states volunteers must be at least 18 unless a programme specifies otherwise. Maker roles need fabrication skills; laptop work needs confidence handling and reassembling devices. Laptop sessions are on weekdays, 10am-5pm, by arrangement.
discovery.notes: Current roles are listed, but a working application form could not be confirmed. Contact contactus@engineeringgood.org for the next step. No application deadline is stated.

additions.title: Food from the Heart - Food Packing and Distribution Volunteering
additions.description: Explore food sorting, packing, surplus bread collection and distribution roles supporting households in Singapore.
additions.eligibility: The official FAQ welcomes all ages and backgrounds. Individual roles may have additional requirements; confirm supervision and availability with the organiser.

discovery.restrictions: The official FAQ welcomes all ages and backgrounds. Individual roles may have additional requirements; confirm supervision and availability with the organiser.
discovery.notes: The current sign-up link returns to the opportunities page; the registration form could not be confirmed. Contact volunteer@foodheart.org for delivery volunteering. No closing date is stated.
